author: smorgasburg
title: Calling all local artists for 2027 NYC vendor flyer
content: Smorgasburg, through your eyes. 🎨 Calling all local artists! We’re looking for a local illustrator or designer to create our 2027 NYC vendor application flyer! This is a paid commission, with full artist credit and the potential for many future collaborations. We want to see something different from our past flyers. Something unmistakably New York that captures the messy, human experience of eating here: hands making food, friends sharing a bite, cultures meeting across a counter. Your style, your perspective. Submit your portfolio or Instagram through the link in bio by November 10. A sketch is optional, but including one helps us understand your vision and may speed up our review—rough ideas are welcome. The final flyer, featuring the selected artist’s work, will be posted on November 20. Know someone we should see? Tag them below. Contact: link in bio.

author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists for animated series
content: 🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project! Requirements: * Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. * Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. * Ability to match an established cartoon art style. * Attention to detail and good artistic skills. Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance). 📩 Send your CV and Portfolio to: * jobs@jumpanimation.com * gawad26@gmail.com 💬 You can also message us directly through Facebook! If you’re passionate about cartoon backgrounds and 2D animation, we’d love to hear from you!

author: egofilm_studio
title: Seeking Lead Illustrator and Background Illustrator
content: 🎬 EGoFILM poszukuje Lead Ilustratora oraz Background Ilustratora! Do nowego projektu serialu animowanego szukamy osoby, która będzie odpowiedzialna między innymi za: • projektowanie i rozwijanie lokacji oraz backgroundów (background ilustrator), • współtworzenie warstwy wizualnej serialu (lead ilustrator), • dbanie o spójność stylistyczną ilustracji (lead ilustrator), • współpracę z Art Directorem, reżyserami oraz zespołem ilustratorów (lead ilustrator). Jeśli masz doświadczenie w pracy przy projektach animowanych, prześlij swoje portfolio na: 📩 rekrutacja@egofilm.pl Do zobaczenia! Contact: rekrutacja@egofilm.pl

author: puffballstudios
title: Artist call for Line Art Finishing Artist for Abida comic
content: 📢📢 ARTIST CALL FOR ABIDA📢📢 Doston, Puffball Comics is officially on a hunt for an exceptional Line Art Finishing Artist to join the production team for @theabidacomic Issue #2 We're looking for someone who can smoothly step into an established visual world and help us complete pages while maintaining the style, character, and energy of the graphic novel. What you'll be working on: ○ Finishing and refining line art / inks ○ Supporting the completion of illustrated pages ○ Adding shadows, lighting, and finishing touches ○ Working from existing artwork, layouts, and visual references under Lead Artist's direction You should apply if you have strong character drawing and anatomy skills, a solid understanding of perspective, movement, and exaggeration, with clean, confident linework. You should also be comfortable adapting to an existing visual style and maintaining consistency across characters, environments, and sequential panels. If this sounds like you, send us your portfolio at contact@puffball.pk
